daily.brief: 過去約26小時有304則貼文、71個帳號參與。最明顯的共識是$TSLA、$PLTR同$AAPL都有明確看好，而最大噪音來自$LITE同$MRVL的收購消息，意見明顯分裂。
daily.full:
共識

$TSLA有6個帳號看好、0個看淡，共20則相關貼文。@TrendSpider指算法剛發出下一個入場信號，策略回報102%對比買入持有79%，勝率58%。原帖。@OptionsHawk則說股價衝破近期高點，熱門看漲期權走勢不錯。原帖。

$PLTR同樣4個看好、0個看淡。@amitisinvesting強調季度收入增長96%、調整後營業收入利潤率62%，美國商業收入首次超過政府收入，同比增148%，淨美元留存率165%。原帖。@TrendSpider亦引用雙超同埋上調指引。原帖。

$AAPL有4個看好。@TrendSpider報第四季每股盈餘2.10美元對比預期1.98美元，營收1144.77億對比1133.92億。原帖。@munster_gene指12月收入指引優於預期，比略軟的利潤率指引更重要。原帖。

共同看淡

$ORCL有3個帳號看淡。@KobeissiLetter指公司宣佈計劃透過股權及債務發行籌集200億美元資助AI建設後，股價跌超過5%，較今年高位已跌54%。原帖。@RedDogT3直言過去一年左右一直是一場災難。原帖。

$CBRS亦有看淡聲音，USB目標由330美元下調至250美元，內部人士可賣股窗口臨近，股價跌破100美元。

分歧

$LITE同$MRVL的收購是最大話題，26則貼文。@michaelsikand覺得時機糟糕，但認為$LITE價值遠超1000美元/股，不會賣出，對光子學整體反而看漲。原帖。但@amitisinvesting覺得交易很糟糕：全股票交易造成嚴重稀釋，2028年才交割，產能已售至2029年卻全部交出。原帖。@garyblack00指出收購價約每股1,132美元，較10/28收盤914美元溢價24%。原帖。

其他值得留意

$SPCX有關於可能收購或使用Boost Mobile網絡的討論，配合Elon Musk的無線計劃。@StockSavvyShay提到約700萬用戶同5G基礎設施。原帖。

briefing.html:
今日重點

過去約一日最清晰的多頭共識落在$TSLA、$PLTR同$AAPL身上，財報數字同技術信號同時出現。最大噪音則是$LITE同$MRVL的收購，有人覺得溢價合理甚至對光子學看漲，有人覺得稀釋嚴重同交割時間太長。$ORCL為AI再籌資後股價再跌，較高位已跌超過一半，成為較集中的看淡聲音。

daily.brief: About 26 hours, 304 posts from 71 accounts. The clearest consensus is bullish on $TSLA, $PLTR and $AAPL, while the biggest noise is the $LITE–$MRVL deal, where views are clearly split.
daily.full:
Consensus

$TSLA had 6 bullish accounts and 0 bearish, across 20 related posts. @TrendSpider said an algorithm just issued the next entry signal; the strategy returned 102% vs 79% buy-and-hold, with a 58% win rate. Post. @OptionsHawk noted the stock broke recent highs with popular call options looking good. Post.

$PLTR also had 4 bullish and 0 bearish. @amitisinvesting highlighted 96% revenue growth, 62% adjusted operating margin, US commercial revenue surpassing government for the first time (+148% YoY), and 165% net dollar retention. Post. @TrendSpider also cited the beat and raised guidance. Post.

$AAPL had 4 bullish accounts. @TrendSpider reported Q4 EPS of $2.10 vs $1.98 expected, revenue $114.477B vs $113.392B. Post. @munster_gene said the better December revenue guide matters more than slightly softer margin guidance. Post.

Shared bearish

$ORCL had 3 bearish accounts. @KobeissiLetter noted the stock fell over 5% after the company announced plans to raise $20B via equity and debt for AI buildout; it is now down 54% from this year’s high. Post. @RedDogT3 called the past year or so a disaster. Post.

$CBRS also saw bearish comments, with a USB target cut from $330 to $250 and the stock falling below $100.

Splits

The $LITE–$MRVL deal was the biggest topic with 26 posts. @michaelsikand thinks the timing is bad but believes $LITE is worth far more than $1,000 a share and is not selling; the bigger takeaway is bullish for photonics overall. Post. @amitisinvesting calls the deal terrible: all-stock creates heavy dilution, closes only in 2028, and capacity is sold through 2029. Post. @garyblack00 noted the offer is about $1,132 per share, a 24% premium to the 10/28 close of $914. Post.

Other notes

$SPCX saw discussion of a possible Boost Mobile acquisition or network use tied to Elon Musk’s wireless plans. @StockSavvyShay mentioned roughly 7 million users and 5G infrastructure. Post.

briefing.html:
Today’s briefing

The clearest bullish consensus over the past day sat on $TSLA, $PLTR and $AAPL, where earnings numbers and technical signals appeared together. The biggest noise was the $LITE–$MRVL deal: some see the premium as reasonable or even bullish for photonics, others flag heavy dilution and a long close timeline. $ORCL fell again after announcing more AI funding and is now down more than half from its high, becoming the more concentrated bearish voice.
